answers.Q2: Lowering retrieval friction is a useful hypothesis to test across human file organization and AI memory. R06 connects these endpoints, but does not establish that human effect sizes or learning mechanisms transfer to AI. R04 supplies no universal optimal hierarchy, and a Markdown folder alone does not implement the AI pipeline (R04–R06).
